integrity: Symbolic all-size necessity and constructive sufficiency, exact integer-rational verification for sampled parameters, no extrapolation from finite checks; publication-priority search is evidence rather than an independence guarantee.
scientific_limitations: One-population symmetric coordination with payoff u>1, binomial independent action sampling, small group size exactly two, large group size an integer at least two, tie-breaking in favor of the high-payoff action, deterministic continuous-time revision dynamics. Existence of an attracting interior state, not global stability or a characterization of all mixing shares.
title: Sharp observation-budget staircase for stable miscoordination in two-size sampling dynamics
